reply.text:
I can't tell you how your hormones will change your body or your training. That depends on your own dosing and bloodwork, and it's a question for your prescriber or an endocrinologist. They know your plan and can tell you what to expect.

What I can do is coach around it. Recovery, strength, endurance and how your body responds to training all show up in your logs, so we track what actually happens session by session instead of guessing. If you want, tell me what you're noticing or what you're aiming for, and I'll look at your numbers with you and keep the program built to match.
